Pace notes page (bar, under RallyWorld): pick the stage with the arrows.
Click the layout: a note is added (the launcher guesses the corner) and its fields open: type, side, grade (H = hairpin, 1 very tight to 6 almost straight), modifiers, free text.
Drag a note to move it; Del or Remove to take it away. Wheel on the layout: zoom; on the page on the right: move along the stage.
A stage you haven't touched keeps the automatic notes. Reset: the stage goes back to them.
Use in game: it's the active notebook, the one the game reads. New, Import, Export: one notebook per style, to share with friends (a small .json file).
A notebook received from a friend is checked before it's taken: a file out of format is refused as a whole.
The layout arrives after a first game with the mod: it writes it for the launcher. While the game is open, the launcher changes nothing: the game is using the notebook.
